description: A benign condition characterised by multiple small dark papules, especially on the face and neck.
causes: Likely genetically determined; lesions resemble small seborrhoeic keratoses
risk_factors: Skin of colour, especially Fitzpatrick phototypes IV–VI

appearance.general: Multiple small smooth firm dark papules on the face and neck, sometimes extending to the upper chest or back.
appearance.dark_skin: Common in skin of colour and particularly associated with Fitzpatrick phototypes IV–VI.

doctor_discussion_points: Discuss any rapidly changing, bleeding, or diagnostically uncertain papule.
